backend/main.mo: Main backend actor implementing student management system with username/password authentication, role-based access control (admin/staff/student), and CRUD operations for students, marks, attendance, and subjects with migration support.
backend/migration.mo: Migration module that handles actor upgrades by preserving nextStudentId and initializing empty user maps for the new authentication system.
feature_evidence.json: Feature evidence report documenting completed authentication system changes including removal of Internet Identity, implementation of username/password login, admin account creation interface, and profile management updates.
frontend-file-summaries.txt: Comprehensive summaries of all frontend components including routing, authentication hooks, student/marks/attendance management pages, forms, and UI components with role-based access control.
frontend/index.css: Global Tailwind CSS styles with custom OKLCH color system defining light and dark mode themes for the education-focused application.
frontend/index.html: HTML entry point for the React application with root div and module script reference to main.tsx.
frontend/src/App.tsx: Main application component configuring TanStack Router with protected routes for login, home, students, marks, attendance, subjects, and account creation pages with authentication guards.
frontend/src/components/AdminGuard.tsx: Higher-order component that restricts access to admin-only content by checking authentication and admin status, displaying appropriate error messages or redirecting non-authorized users.
frontend/src/components/AttendanceForm.t: Form component for recording student attendance with date, student ID, and present/absent toggle. Restricted to admin users only and includes alerts about daily updates and manual student ID entry.
frontend/src/components/AttendanceHistor: Displays attendance history for a selected student with statistics (attendance rate, present/absent counts) and a scrollable list of recent attendance records with visual indicators.
frontend/src/components/Layout.tsx: Main layout component with responsive navigation header, logo, role-based menu items (admin-only routes), user profile display, and logout functionality. Includes mobile menu support.
frontend/src/components/MarkForm.tsx: Form for adding student marks with subject selection (from backend), exam type, and score fields. Admin-only access with alerts about automatic handling of new entries and updates.
frontend/src/components/MarksHistory.tsx: Displays student marks grouped by subject with grade calculation (A+ to F), performance icons (trending up/down), and color-coded badges for each exam entry.
frontend/src/components/StudentForm.tsx: Form component for adding new students with fields for name, roll number, grade, and contact information. Clears form on successful submission.
frontend/src/components/SubjectManagemen: React component for managing test subjects with add and edit functionality, using custom hooks for data fetching and mutations, wrapped in AdminGuard for access control.
frontend/src/hooks/useActor.ts: Custom hook that creates and manages the backend actor instance with authentication, initializing access control with admin token and invalidating dependent queries when the actor changes.
frontend/src/hooks/useAuth.ts: Authentication hook managing user login/logout state with token-based session storage, providing user profile info and role-based access checks (admin/staff/student).
frontend/src/hooks/useInternetIdentity.t: React context provider and hook for Internet Identity authentication, managing identity state, login flow, and delegation validation with configurable AuthClient options.
frontend/src/hooks/useQueries.ts: Collection of React Query hooks for data fetching and mutations including user profiles, students, subjects, marks, and attendance with toast notifications and cache invalidation.
frontend/src/index.css: Tailwind CSS configuration with custom CSS variables for light and dark theme colors including primary, secondary, accent, and sidebar color schemes using oklch color space.
frontend/src/main.tsx: Application entry point that sets up React root with QueryClientProvider for data fetching and InternetIdentityProvider for authentication context.
frontend/src/pages/AccountCreationPage.t: Admin-only page component for creating new user accounts with username, password, name, and role selection (student/staff/admin), using form validation and toast notifications.
frontend/src/pages/AttendancePage.tsx: Attendance management page with a two-column layout showing an attendance recording form and attendance history viewer. Requires authentication and redirects to login if not authenticated.
frontend/src/pages/HomePage.tsx: Dashboard homepage displaying a hero banner with user greeting, three feature cards (Students, Marks, Attendance) linking to respective pages, and a quick stats section. Requires authentication.
frontend/src/pages/LoginPage.tsx: Login page with username/password form, password visibility toggle, and branding for Tarun Coaching Center. Redirects authenticated users to homepage.
frontend/src/pages/MarksPage.tsx: Marks management page with two-column layout containing a mark entry form and marks history viewer. Requires authentication and redirects to login if not authenticated.
frontend/src/pages/StudentsPage.tsx: Student management page with search functionality and add student dialog (admin only). Displays alert noting missing backend methods (getAllStudents, updateStudent, deleteStudent) preventing full implementation.
frontend/src/pages/SubjectsPage.tsx: Subject management page that renders the SubjectManagement component for adding and managing test subjects. Requires authentication.
frontend/src/utils/urlParams.ts: Utility functions for extracting, storing, and managing URL parameters from both regular query strings and hash-based routing, with sessionStorage persistence support and parameter cleanup functionality.
frontend/tailwind.config.js: Tailwind CSS configuration file defining custom theme extensions including OKLCH color system with CSS variables, custom fonts (Inter, Poppins), container settings, border radius variables, custom shadows, and accordion animations.
project_state.json: Project state document for Tarun Coaching Center's student marks and attendance tracking application, detailing architectural decisions (admin-controlled username/password auth, role-based access), existing features (student records, marks, attendance, test subject management), and UI theming requirements.
